notes.title: DAMN! PC is underway, demo coming in 2025!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38507232/f02dfb5d562836c9cda19670b8de77d09f83b42a.png
Hey there everyone, as we close in on the full official release for DAMN! Nation and exit Early Access, we’re preparing to gear up and shift some of our focus and resources over to the main event — Demons Ate My Neighbors!, AKA DAMN!

Upcoming Community Address

With us beginning to refocus on Demons Ate My Neighbors!, it's important for us to be transparent to the community. A lot has happened behind the scenes, and now that legalities have cleared up, we want to tell our story. The story of DAMN!, how it was created as an idea, how it was (almost) destroyed by Covid 19, and how after 6 more years of industry experience, the returning members are ready to bring the game to life once again. We know DAMN! Nation was not the game you were waiting for, but as you'll learn in this upcoming Community Address, the source code for DAMN! '21 was sadly lost in the sands of time. The Nation Deal vitally allowed us to begin work for DAMN! PC, by letting us properly create code for Characters, Enemies, Mechanics, and even 85 brand-new items, all relatively without worry. Serving as a massive boost in our journey to create Demons Ate My Neighbors!

In this addressment we'll be discussing all that, and the future, in both text and video format. Because we feel like you all deserve to know, and we really want you to understand that we want this game just as much as you do, and we appreciate you all staying here as long as you have.

It's on our minds!

Currently, we're working to determine the future of DAMN! Such as what we're carrying over from Nation, what we're preserving from DAMN! '19-'21, and what we're planning for the 2025 Demo, and future release. (Elaborated below)

DAMN! PC vs DAMN! Nation

Although it may be obvious, we want to absolutely set the record straight, and remind you all that DAMN! PC and DAMN! Nation are built for entirely different platforms, and thus will NOT share the following features seen in Nation.


 Ads
 Any form of Web3 or Crypto integration
 Microtransactions
 An energy system
 Autoshooter gameplay


With the creation of Nation though, many things introduced in it were always intended to appear in DAMN! PC, so whilst we had a paid budget, we made sure to create them!


 VH$ and the VH$Ending Machine
 Perma-Pops!
 All Enemies (Zombos, Bats, Vampunks, Zaplings, Tarmen, and Ohmlings.)
 Sheriff Pickens and The Ice Cream Man Bosses (Since Nation is a prequel and Joey will be playable in DAMN! PC, he can't be a boss in PC. We may find a way to preserve his boss behavior though.)
 All Citizens and Tuned Out Citizens! (Sergeant Sally, Gigi & Maurice, Margot Rita, Cheerleader Girl, and Father Romero.)
 All 85 Items (15 Actives, 11 Nozzles, and 55 Passives!)
 Romero Residences, both the outside streets and inside houses. Alongside Crystal Lake Mall. (Crystal Lake Mall actually had no graphics prior to Nation).
 All music tracks heard in Nation!

and just to be clear...
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38507232/cfd2bd40338b941f59bc0eaebe32c3405b480576.png
DAMN! PC will be a TWIN STICK SHOOTER and have 2 PLAYER COOP

You're involved in our future!

We wouldn't be here if it wasn't for you. Literally. You may have noticed that our original Discord Server has been removed, this was due to an unfortunate hack we suffered, but we've gotten control back, and we'd greatly appreciate you rejoining so you can take advantage of these brand new features we've worked on to improve your server experience!

Just to list some of the changes:


 We have roles that you can choose to be pinged for only the projects you're interested in.
 We have a news forum where you can filter by only the news you're interested in.
 We've created a channel where you can post questions for us to answer about DAMN! PC or Nation.
 We've created a channel where we'll post possible changes we're considering for DAMN! PC, so we can get your valued opinion. Currently we're discussing the possibility of turning our characters from Pixel Art into Low Poly 3D Models, with various reasons behind this possible decision. Please, join and discuss with us!


Alongside that, we'll also be posting more often about DAMN! PC in general, including more insights into it's Beta elements, such as mechanics, characters, items, and environments NEVER BEFORE REVEALED TO THE PUBLIC. Some of these may be cut forever, and some may be carried over! You'll just have to wait and see.

In Conclusion...

The future of Demons Ate My Neighbors! is looking bright, and we're eager to share it with you. This isn't quite the end for DAMN! Nation, it's only just the beginning for DAMN! PC.

notes.title: 🔥 DAMN! Demons Ate My Neighbors! is BACK, BABY! 🔫
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38507232/f64086a1ad628c599019340e58a33fcff4473d03.gif
Hey Neighbors! 🧟
After a longer and more complex hiatus than anyone could have predicted, we're beyond thrilled to announce that the DAMN! IP is making a fierce comeback with two major game announcements!

A Little Backstory
In 2019, we launched a Kickstarter for Demons Ate My Neighbors! with big ambitions: to create a love letter to classic 90s run-and-gun games, spiced up with the intensity of roguelite shooters like The Binding of Isaac and Enter the Gungeon, all mixed with the goofy co-op energy of ToeJam & Earl. We were ready to bring you this vision—even got Macaulay Culkin involved! But after factoring in Kickstarter rewards, fees, and production costs, we realized we needed to scale up our resources to bring the full vision to life.

The challenges of COVID and the need for a clear plan led us to put the project on pause while we sharpened our focus. Today, we’re thrilled to share that we’ve secured outside support to relaunch the DAMN! project—and with fresh momentum, we’re announcing two titles currently in development: DAMN! Nation and Demons Ate My Neighbors! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38507232/aa90560e63d10f614cb9c7ac879246b8e207f35c.png

And that’s not all—Tuned-Out Games has evolved into Curse Free Studios, which will be producing and publishing all DAMN! IP titles moving forward!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38507232/e77d040cba4a48a06138b61a7cf9a6a132f69755.png
Introducing DAMN! Nation – Launching Early 2025
DAMN! Nation is a free-to-play mobile game, designed as a one-handed, single-player experience that introduces players to the world and characters of DAMN! Step into the shoes of April in this action-packed prologue to the main story of Demons Ate My Neighbors! 📲

DAMN! Nation will launch in a closed beta this December and then will be available for public consumption early 2025. It will be available on iOS, Android, and Quest headsets (as a 2D app)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38507232/88de63228c058dd8038982b8fec6bbd5963dd144.png
While we have no plans to implement blockchain technology in Demons Ate My Neighbors!, when it comes to our partnership agreement for DAMN! Nation, we’re implementing blockchain technology to store run data, providing a transparent, public leaderboard to keep things fair and track performance trends.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38507232/8ea47c3df43fdf9bde7c0e8bbb8b76bbd5dc6863.png

We know some players have concerns about this tech, but we want to be open from the start of our new relationship with you as a potential fan: it was the best path to secure funding and bring the IP back to life.

 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38507232/e2fe5164b311dafc044def3d8cd0688b2047c06b.png

Rest assured, despite the blockchain implementation, this partnership has enabled us to make a game focused on fun first. It’s a completely optional feature that exists to add some transaction data to the chain alongside providing those who choose to opt in additional benefits such as achievements and token airdrops on a companion app.

Our new funding will bring DAMN! Nation to life, with the hope that its success will pave the way for us to realize the original vision of Demons Ate My Neighbors! fully. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38507232/fc8819869161f18b95dc5abe00213fd8d06dcc5c.png

Looking Toward the Core Vision of Creating Demons Ate My Neighbors!
Our new funding will bring DAMN! Nation to life, and we’re hopeful its success will pave the way for us to fully realize our original vision for Demons Ate My Neighbors! 

Our plan remains mostly the same - a fully fleshed out, “traditional” roguelike action game for 2-player co-op. We loved growing up with the vibes of Zombies ate my Neighbors, and have lost 100s of hours playing The Binding of Isaac, and if we can combine the complexity and depth with the wacky 90’s vibes, with just a pinch of ToeJam & Earl’s kooky co-op funkiness, we think we have the recipe for something really special.

Again, this will be the original vision that I think many of you originally became early fans of, and we hope if you’re not interested in DAMN! Nation, you’ll stay tuned for Demons Ate My Neighbors!

Please consider wishlisting Demons Ate My Neighbors! on Steam and help us create the buzz we need to explore additional funding and publishing opportunities! 🎮

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38507232/fc8819869161f18b95dc5abe00213fd8d06dcc5c.png

Going forward, you can expect regular updates on both games, including details on gameplay, systems, and artwork. The vibe remains true to the original vision: in both DAMN! Nation and Demons Ate My Neighbors!, you’ll wield an upgradable squirt gun to cleanse the neighborhood of monstrous infestations in a dynamic, evolving roguelite world. 🧠💥

You’re the ones who inspired us to keep chasing this dream and hopefully bring it to reality one day. Join us on Discord to share your thoughts and let us know what you’d love to see next! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38507232/7f6eee7bedd986d6498db9eb5ca0ecac2adc7c37.png
📩 Stay tuned for more updates & sneak peeks on our social channels!
Discord, X, Facebook, Instagram, as well as Curse Free Studios on Linkedin (ew) and YouTube, where we plan to upload some never-before-seen footage of some of Demons Ate My Neighbors!'s prototypes!

We can't wait to show you more and your unearthly patience.

Catch you on the flip side,
Curse Free Studios 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38507232/e0b5534afb942cc441c0452d31885302129f6dcc.jpg
